summary: Checked the durability side of client completion: the engine's two apply passes straddle logdb.SaveRaftState, and setFastApply disables the early pass whenever the update carries a snapshot or when the last committed entry falls inside the range being saved that round, so entries written in the current round reach the state machine only after the write returns. Recorded the step ordering as a knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account, keeping the two honest bounds (asynchronous apply delivery, and local log state that can trail the applied index when fast-apply runs). No execution requested.
